clips.title: The story
paras: In northern Tirisfal, the Agamand Family Sword remains in the family crypt. The tarnished blade once marked the wealth and standing of the mill-owning dynasty, and Coleman Farthing now seeks it to erase their legacy.

The Agamands once held great wealth and influence through their mills in northern Tirisfal Glades. When the Scourge swept through Lordaeron, the family met a gruesome end, and their bodies rose as mindless thralls of the Lich King. Their ancestral weapons, including the ceremonial sword, were sealed inside the Agamand Family Crypt at the northern edge of the mills. Taking these blades from their burial racks is an act meant to break the memory and noble standing of the fallen household.
